harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created “OS Comparison Root CA” on node1 and installed it in Ubuntu 7.10’s system trust store. Trust, protected key persistence, unchanged OS/kernel, and node recovery were verified after a safe reboot.
actions_performed: Installed Gutsy-native OpenSSL 0.9.8e and ca-certificates packages.
Generated a 2048-bit self-signed CA with CA:TRUE and a SHA-256 signature.
Registered the CA using Gutsy’s /usr/share/ca-certificates and /etc/ca-certificates.conf mechanism.
Verified newly issued probe certificates through both the explicit system CA bundle and default trust path.
Restarted node1 exactly once and verified its changed boot identity and recovered state.

evidence.requirement: Create and install OS Comparison Root CA as a trusted system CA
evidence.summary: Shows native trust registration, exact CA subject, CA:TRUE, matching protected key, and successful system trust verification before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel and use legacy-compatible software
evidence.summary: Shows Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic unchanged, using packages from the Gutsy archive.
Captures healthy baseline boot ID 26030e42-…, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID e44c68fb-…, and recovered certificate trust, key, network, and SSH health.
